items.text: How did the government boost its sales?

items.text: The company isn't running the ads, is it?

items.text: My husband is winning, isn't he?

items.text: Coca-Cola is also based in Atlanta, isn't it?

items.text: Why is the judge refusing to stop the switch?
It will seek arbitration, won't it?

items.text: You can't attend the party because you have a previous engagement, can you?

items.text: Did you get there on time?
